lessons.observation: Structural branch differentiation alone did not create felt agency or perceived consequence in the first slice.
lessons.outcome: Human Gate requested revision despite passing machine QA.
lessons.scope: Interactive narrative slices with stateful choices.

lessons.observation: Active observation, persistent world state, and a pre-reflection enacted consequence improved immersion, agency, consequence, and pacing in the revised slice.

lessons.observation: Repeated three-way interaction structure was perceived as act sameness even when content and state differed.
lessons.outcome: M4.3 feedback requested revision; M4.3R introduced three distinct primitives.

lessons.observation: Choice Memory became perceptible and was explicitly preserved through later revisions.

lessons.observation: Correct state history alone was insufficient for a felt journey; scene progression and narrative motion mattered separately.
lessons.outcome: The prior experience was judged too short with insufficient scene change and motion; the revision added continuous regions and semantic travel motion, but the final human replay questions remain unanswered.
lessons.scope: Wayfinder; final subjective effect remains unvalidated.

lessons.observation: Agent-generated improvements required repeated Human Gate validation rather than inferred approval from automated checks.
lessons.outcome: A passing machine chain never approved the experience or release; the final replaytest remains historically pending at closure.

candidateRules.proposedRule: For interactive narrative work, automated branch-state differentiation must not substitute for a Human Gate testing felt consequence before explanatory text.
supportingHumanEvidence: M4.2 Human Playtest rejected perceived consequence and felt agency.
supportingMachineEvidence: M4.2 QA passed deterministic branch differences.
limitations: One pilot and one interaction genre; no cross-context replication.
candidateRules.promotionRequirement: Successful evidence from one materially different later pilot, explicit human validation with strong cross-context rationale, or controlled comparative evidence.

candidateRules.proposedRule: When major decisions share an interaction primitive, test perceived act differentiation before expanding content volume.

limitations: M4.3R's final subjective differentiation was not replaytested before closure.
